findings.statement: Among the collected social posts, discussions of NVIDIA GPU performance show a largely positive sentiment.
limitations: Evidence comes exclusively from X (Twitter) posts.
Data is overwhelmingly in English (95 out of 97 items).

findings.statement: Social posts about AMD GPU support express uniformly positive sentiment.
limitations: Only English language content is represented.

findings.statement: Cloud providers are offering NVIDIA H100 GPU hosts at reduced hourly rates, indicating growing adoption and price sensitivity among AI developers.
limitations: Evidence is limited to social media posts without broader market data.

findings.statement: Intel data‑center AI accelerators are not mentioned in any of the collected evidence, while AMD and NVIDIA accelerators appear in multiple posts, indicating lower visibility of Intel in the sampled discourse.
limitations: The finding is based on the absence of Intel mentions rather than explicit statements.
Sample is heavily weighted toward X posts and English language.
